newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine gays attack military discrimination.
newsitem.headline: Philippine gays attack military discrimination.

text.p: Hundreds of homosexuals marched through Manila's streets on Saturday to protest at discrimination against gays in the Philippine armed forces.
"Gays should be given the choice whether they want to serve their country or not," a gay wearing a police uniform said.
Armed Forces chief Arnulfo Acedera created a stir recently when he said gays were barred from joining the military under the rules of the Philippine armed forces.
The gays and lesbians asked military officers to stop issuing discriminatory statements against them.
They also asked that a bill filed in the House of Representatives banning sex change operations in the country be withdrawn.
Some 300 people took part in the "pride march". Some men wore bras beneath unbuttoned fatigue uniforms and carried guns, attracting curious onlookers.
